results: A shared tame H1 convolution estimate retains one absolute Fourier-sum factor. Native conjugation preserves that sum. The already verified Hilbert Agmon estimate therefore controls the quadratic conjugate product on the full original H1 domain.

Every original complex H-minus-one potential has the actual normalized quadratic product bound norm(S(q*f,f))<=norm(f)_H1^2/4+93312*norm(q)_Hminus1^4*norm(f)_L2^2, without any smoothness, endpoint cutoff or reality assumption on q.

The original domain-inclusion energy equals the true squared normalized L2 coefficient norm. The free singular Hill energy equals the squared genuine period-two derivative norm, retaining pi^2*k^2. The entire original H1 norm squared is at most twice the sum of those two energies.

For C(Q)=1+93312*Q^4, every original complex H-minus-one singular weak form has Re(S(L(q)f,f))>=one_half*free_energy-C(norm(q))*base_energy. Every actual full-domain eigenvalue obeys Re(z)>=-C(norm(q)),abs(Im(z))<=Re(z)+2*C(norm(q)) and norm(z)<=2*Re(z)+4*C(norm(q)).

The global actual endpoint Fredholm alternative transfers those bounds to EVERY point of the full complex endpoint spectrum. Every left real half-plane contains only finitely many actual spectral values. Native real endpoint potentials have an actual lowest eigenvalue, using this finiteness and a proved nonempty high pair.

Original complex source norm balls have one explicit lower/sector bound using the true norm of the original endpoint-to-H-minus-one inclusion. The left of that lower bound lies in the full original H1-to-H-minus-one resolvent. All source distributions and norms are retained.

The actual finite central source spectrum is defined strictly below free_N-12N, and sourceCentralAlgebraicCount is the finite sum of ACTUAL physical algebraic multiplicities there. Each included multiplicity is positive. The required value2N-1 is not assumed or proved by these definitions.

The high-region edge lies strictly between the adjacent FREE centers free_(N-1) and free_N for N>=2. A single rectangle chosen before every complex source potential on a fixed original norm ball has all its sides in the full original physical resolvent and contains every actual central spectral point strictly inside. The left/horizontal sides use the sector estimate; the right side uses actual wide localization.
qualifications: The original potential is not replaced by an auxiliary sequence or smoother model. The H1 domain itself is Hilbert; its base and derivative coefficients are used with exact original duality.
No convergence of Fourier truncations in the source infinity norm is assumed. The multiplicative Hilbert embedding directly proves the form bound.
Finite central spectrum, an actual lowest eigenvalue and a common resolvent boundary do NOT by themselves prove the central count2N-1 or its homotopy invariance.

The defined rectangular side set has proved positive height/nonempty real interior and full physical resolvent on all sides; an eventual contour/counting construction must still be connected to actual physical algebraic multiplicities.
No canonical global label, Birkhoff map, KdV frequency or physical KdV flow is claimed complete.
